title: Bakery and Kitchen Again
author: Silas Vasquez
blurb: Hazel Pemberton, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must forgive the person in the mirror first before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
